Name: Mushroom Box Location Framework
Author: AnotherPillow
Description:
A mod to allow modders to edit the mushroom box default locations in the Farm Cave.

An example of how to use this mod in yours can be found [url=https://github.com/AnotherPillow/MushroomBoxLocationFramework/tree/main/%5BCP%5D%20Mushroom%20Box%20Example%20Mod]on the Github repository[/url]﻿.
